CURRENT SCENE:
古代的时候有一个人叫神农。他需要当上医，一看别的人就想帮助他们。但是，他有一个问题，他不知道什么东西能做药。神农听说一个远远的地方有一种植物，什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好。神农三个月走去，找到有植物的地方，他看到一个很漂亮的植物，又香又好看。

FLAGGED PLACES:

[P299] 【古代的时候】有一个人叫神农
  proposed by the teacher's pattern/rule: [古代的时候→在古代]有一个人叫神农 (her pattern: 古代的时候 -> 在古代 (corrected 18/30 in train))
  her past correction (first_mention_introduction): 在古代[有一个神农→有一个叫神农的老人]
  her past correction (redundant_words): ⟦很久以前，在古代⟧有一个叫神农的老人 — her note: “很久以前“ and ”在古代” are redundant, only keep one
  her past correction (fixed_expressions): 这是[一个神农的→关于神农的]古代故事
  rule card location_with_zai: Use 在+Place for a location: put the location before the action as 在Place + V., or use 住在+Place. Add 里/上 when needed to make the place clear. Not an error: Do not add 上 after every place word: 农村 is already a place, so use 在农村住, not 在农村上住.
  rule card first_mention_introduction: When a character first appears, briefly introduce the person with an identifying noun phrase, not only a name or pronoun. The first appearing noun should not be specific. Not an error: After a character has already been introduced, this rule does not require another brief introduction.

[P300] 他需要当【上】医
  proposed by the correction model: 他需要当[-上]医
  her past correction (redundant_words): 他现在是[-当]医生 — her note: redundant with是
  her past correction (not_but_refutation): 他那[不是成为→没有当]医生 — her note: “不是……而是……” is used to refute something conventional and affirm something unexpected, and to correct something wrong
  her past correction (redundant_words): 他[-那]不是成为医生
  rule card redundant_words: Delete words, names, time phrases, or repeated structures when they add no new meaning or repeat information already given. For example, do not add 当 after 是, and do not use two words that express the same time or idea. Not an error: Do not delete a word if it adds a different meaning, such as a different time, person, or detail. Only flag words or structures that repeat information already expressed.
  rule card not_but_refutation: Use 不是……而是…… only to correct a conventional or mistaken idea with an unexpected alternative. Put the subject before 不是……而是…… when both alternatives have the same subject. Not an error: Do not flag a sentence that genuinely corrects a mistaken or conventional idea with an unexpected alternative. Do not use this pattern merely to connect two unrelated actions, places, or ideas.

[P301] 他需要当上【医】
  proposed by the AI checker: 他需要当上[医→医生] (医 alone is not the usual word for a doctor here)
  proposed by the correction model: 他需要当上医[+生]
  her past correction (redundant_words): 他现在是[-当]医生 — her note: redundant with是
  her past correction (not_but_refutation): 他那[不是成为→没有当]医生 — her note: “不是……而是……” is used to refute something conventional and affirm something unexpected, and to correct something wrong
  her past correction (missing_or_unclear_subject): [+他]就生病了 — her note: otherwise it is ambiguous who gets sick
  rule card redundant_words: Delete words, names, time phrases, or repeated structures when they add no new meaning or repeat information already given. For example, do not add 当 after 是, and do not use two words that express the same time or idea. Not an error: Do not delete a word if it adds a different meaning, such as a different time, person, or detail. Only flag words or structures that repeat information already expressed.
  rule card not_but_refutation: Use 不是……而是…… only to correct a conventional or mistaken idea with an unexpected alternative. Put the subject before 不是……而是…… when both alternatives have the same subject. Not an error: Do not flag a sentence that genuinely corrects a mistaken or conventional idea with an unexpected alternative. Do not use this pattern merely to connect two unrelated actions, places, or ideas.

[P302] 【一看别的人】就想帮助他们
  proposed by the teacher's pattern/rule: [一看→一看到]别的人就想帮助他们 (her pattern: 一看 -> 一看到 (corrected 10/15 in train))
  proposed by the teacher's pattern/rule: 一[看→看到]别的人就想帮助他们 (her pattern: 看 -> 看到 (corrected 37/71 in train))
  proposed by the correction model: 一看[+到]别的人就想帮助他们
  proposed by the teacher's pattern/rule: 一看[-别的人]就想帮助他们 (her pattern: 别的人 -> (delete) (corrected 8/8 in train))
  her past correction (zero_redundant_pronoun): [-他]想帮他们 — her note: redundant
  her past correction (conditional_jiu): 他[+就]想帮忙
  her past correction (redundant_words): [-他]想帮忙 — her note: redundant
  rule card perception_look_see: 看 is “look”; 看到 is “see/catch sight of” and shows that the person actually sees something. Use 看到 when the narrative gives the result of seeing. Not an error: Do not flag 看 when the meaning is only “look,” rather than successfully seeing something. 看到 does not always need 了.
  rule card other_vs_additional: 别的 is for a different type or for all others except the one already mentioned. 另外 is for an additional quantity, or for another/the other; say 另外一个人, not 别个人. Not an error: Do not flag 别的 when it means a different type or all others except the one already mentioned.

[P303] 【他】不知道什么东西能做药
  proposed by the teacher's pattern/rule: [-他]不知道什么东西能做药 (他 repeats the subject of the clause before: zero form)
  her past correction (zero_redundant_pronoun): [-他]看到了药 — her note: redundant
  her past correction (ambiguous_pronoun): ⟦它⟧可以做药 — her note: “它“ is unclear, it seems that it refers to夹竹桃，which is a poison, not a medicine
  her past correction (zero_redundant_pronoun): [-他]决定找出什么植物可以吃
  rule card zero_redundant_pronoun: When the same person or thing is already clear in the same clause or close continuation, delete the repeated subject or possessive: use zero form. In 不是……而是……, put the subject before 不是 and do not repeat it after 而是. Not an error: Do not delete a subject when it is needed before 不是……而是……; place it before 不是 instead.
  rule card ambiguous_pronoun: Use 他/她/它/他们 only when it is clear who or what they refer to. If more than one person or thing is possible, repeat the name or use a clear noun phrase. Not an error: A pronoun is fine when its referent is close and unambiguous. Do not use 你 for a story character when it refers to the reader instead.

[P304] 神农听说【^】一个远远的地方有一种植物
  proposed by the correction model: 神农听说[+在]一个远远的地方有一种植物
  her past correction (le_completed): 神农[发现→发现了]很多植物 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction (modal_and_control_verb_complements): 神农[什么想尝→想尝什么植物]
  her past correction (collocation_selection): 神农[加→吃]下去很多的植物
  rule card le_completed: Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb. Not an error: Do not flag an action just because it has a verb: if it is not about completion, no 了. An ongoing action can use 着 instead of 了.
  rule card modal_and_control_verb_complements: 想 must be followed by a verb phrase, not a noun; use 想让 + person + V. when you mean “want someone to do something.” 叫/让 + V. expresses an action someone is told or made to do, so do not add 了. Not an error: Do not flag 想 when it is followed by a verb phrase, such as 想尝什么植物. Do not add 了 to 叫/让 when it is followed by the action someone is told or made to do.

[P305] 神农听说一个【远远】的地方有一种植物
  proposed by the AI checker: 神农听说一个[远远→很远]的地方有一种植物 (很远的地方 is the standard expression)
  her past correction (le_completed): 神农[发现→发现了]很多植物 — her note: 了completed
  her past correction (modal_and_control_verb_complements): 神农[什么想尝→想尝什么植物]
  her past correction (le_completed): 神农的朋友给[+了]他这植物 — her note: 了completed
  rule card le_completed: Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb. Not an error: Do not flag an action just because it has a verb: if it is not about completion, no 了. An ongoing action can use 着 instead of 了.
  rule card modal_and_control_verb_complements: 想 must be followed by a verb phrase, not a noun; use 想让 + person + V. when you mean “want someone to do something.” 叫/让 + V. expresses an action someone is told or made to do, so do not add 了. Not an error: Do not flag 想 when it is followed by a verb phrase, such as 想尝什么植物. Do not add 了 to 叫/让 when it is followed by the action someone is told or made to do.

[P306] 什么病人吃【^】都会觉得身体更好
  proposed by the correction model: 什么病人吃[+了]都会觉得身体更好
  her past correction (le_completed): 有的人吃的生病[+了]
  her past correction (le_completed): 感觉得身体健康[+了]
  her past correction (time_sequence_markers): 有的人吃[的→了以后]生病
  rule card le_completed: Use 了 for an action completed in the narrative or for a change of state (了completed). Do not use 了 merely because there is an action verb. Not an error: Do not flag an action just because it has a verb: if it is not about completion, no 了. An ongoing action can use 着 instead of 了.
  rule card time_sequence_markers: Use Time + 以后 after a completed time or action to show “after”; when moving to a later event in the story, use 后来 or 然后 rather than 以后 by itself. Do not add 以后 when the time phrase already says the time clearly. Not an error: Do not use 结果 merely as a general later-time connector; it is for an unexpected result. Use 后来 for a later development instead.

[P307] 神农【三个月走去】
  proposed by the AI checker: 神农[三个月走去→走了三个月] (duration and verb order are incorrect here)
  proposed by the correction model: 神农[+走了]三个月走去
  proposed by the correction model: 神农三个月[-走去]
  proposed by the teacher's pattern/rule: 神农三个月[走去→走着] (her pattern: 走去 -> 走着 (corrected 5/5 in train))
  her past correction (redundant_words): 神农一走路就[-走]到了
  her past correction (redundant_words): 神农一走[-路]就走到了
  her past correction (zhe_durative): 神农很常[走去→走着]找饭 — her note: 走着durative
  rule card zhe_durative: Use 着 for a durative, accompanying, or static state. When one action accompanies the main action, use V.着 + V2 (for example, 牵着驴走). Not an error: Do not use 着 when the action is completed, such as 吃了夹竹桃以后 (了completed). Do not change 和/跟 + noun when both nouns perform the same action.
  rule card redundant_words: Delete words, names, time phrases, or repeated structures when they add no new meaning or repeat information already given. For example, do not add 当 after 是, and do not use two words that express the same time or idea. Not an error: Do not delete a word if it adds a different meaning, such as a different time, person, or detail. Only flag words or structures that repeat information already expressed.

[P308] 找到有【^】植物的地方
  proposed by the AI checker: 找到有[+这种]植物的地方 (it should refer to the specific plant mentioned earlier)
  her past correction (search_find): 他[找有的花→找到一种植物] — her note: 找look for vs.找到find
  her past correction (modifier_de_structure): 他找到了很多[-的]中国的植物
  her past correction (collocation_selection): 找到了很多[对做好饭→能做饭]的植物
  rule card search_find: 找 means “look for.” Use 找到 when the person successfully finds something. Not an error: Do not use this rule when the meaning is only “look for” and does not include a successful result.
  rule card modifier_de_structure: Use 的 after a modifier when it describes a noun, especially a longer phrase such as 人类创造的文明 or 能吃的植物. Do not add 的 after quantity words or fixed modifiers where it is not needed, such as 很多人, 一些人, 今天清晨, 蓝色衣服, and 好主意. Not an error: Do not flag 的 in modifiers that need it, such as 有毒的植物, 中国的植物, or 穿着蓝色衣服的人. Do not add 的 after short fixed modifiers such as 很多, 一些, 今天, 蓝色, or 好 in the examples shown.

[P309] 他看到一【个】很漂亮的植物
  proposed by the AI checker: 他看到一[个→株]很漂亮的植物 (株 is the measure word for plants)
  her past correction (perception_look_see): 他一[看→看到]植物就吃 — her note: 看look vs.看到see
  her past correction (perception_look_see): 然后他们[看了→看到了]很多植物 — her note: 看look vs.看到see
  her past correction (perception_look_see): [看很多植物→看到了很多植物] — her note: 看look vs.看到see
  rule card perception_look_see: 看 is “look”; 看到 is “see/catch sight of” and shows that the person actually sees something. Use 看到 when the narrative gives the result of seeing. Not an error: Do not flag 看 when the meaning is only “look,” rather than successfully seeing something. 看到 does not always need 了.

places.reason: Natural time expression; 在古代 is only a stylistic alternative.
当上 expresses successfully becoming a doctor and is not redundant.
医 alone is not the usual noun for a doctor here.
The sentence describes seeing people as the trigger for the result.
The subject is already clear from the close preceding clause.
听说一个地方有…… is grammatical without 在.
远远的地方 is an acceptable expression.
吃了 marks the completed eating before the resulting feeling.
Duration should follow the completed verb in this narrative action.
有植物的地方 is grammatical and coherent without 这种.
个 is an acceptable general measure word at this level.
